subject: ela
intro: Pick the best way to speak clearly.

items.prompt:
To be heard by the class, you should:
A) whisper
B) speak so everyone can hear
C) say nothing
items.answer: B) speak so everyone can hear

solution.answer: B) speak so everyone can hear

items.prompt:
'Audibly' means:
A) too quiet to hear
B) loud enough to hear
C) very fast

A clear way to tell a feeling is:
A) 'I feel happy.'
B) mumble
C) look away

steps: Name the feeling clearly. Key is A.

items.prompt:
If a friend cannot hear you, you should:
A) speak a little louder and clearly
B) stop talking forever
C) cover your mouth
items.answer: A) speak a little louder and clearly

steps: Speak up and clearly. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) speak a little louder and clearly

items.prompt:
Speaking clearly means you do NOT:
A) say each word
B) mumble
C) face your listener

steps: Mumbling is unclear. Key is B.

items.prompt:
'I think dogs are fun' shares your:
A) idea
B) shoe size
C) phone number

steps: Shares a thought. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Which is the BEST way to share in class?
A) Speak clearly, loud enough, at a good speed
B) Mumble very fast
C) Whisper so no one hears
items.answer: A) Speak clearly, loud enough, at a good speed

steps: Clear, audible, paced. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) Speak clearly, loud enough, at a good speed

items.prompt:
Which sentence clearly shares a feeling AND a reason?
A) I feel happy because it is my birthday.
B) Dog.
C) (silence)
items.answer: A) I feel happy because it is my birthday.

steps: Feeling plus reason, said clearly. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) I feel happy because it is my birthday.
